Data-protection + model-ownership sign-off; EU AI Act role recorded as provider (model modified); GDPR lawful basis for training + right-to-erasure mitigation (train on de-identified data, documented retention, re-train-to-forget) (AISEC-742)

Full behavior re-test on the fine-tuned artifact at R3 bars (refusal >= 98% zero-crit, hallucination <= 2%); base-vs-fine-tuned delta for capability regression; training-data memorization/extraction probe (AISEC-742)
R3 attack battery incl. human red-team pass; jailbreak/injection/leakage/extraction; base-vs-fine-tuned alignment-erosion diff; no critical survived (AISEC-742)
